claim_en: THE TEN-DAY-OLD ZAVAH IS SEVEN PLUS THREE. Mishnah Niddah 5:3's ten days = the seven of separation (15:19) + the three of 'many days' (15:25, Section 5 9), computed; the Sifra's twenty-five and hundred (Section 5 3-4) summed from the same clocks; living water at the zav alone. Filed F-210, auto-seated (sitting L2).
middah: ink (the ten-day-old discharger is seven plus three — Niddah 5:3's ten computed from 15:19 and 15:25's own numbers; the Sifra's twenty-five and hundred summed from the same clocks)
